acceptanceCriteria: A decision records whether committed-range paths keep the dirty naming or get a distinct label; if renamed, the wire change follows the affected-plan compatibility rules, with tests.
body: Found during the Beamfall Corvint setup rollout (2026-10-20, corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 676). Suspected naming issue, not a confirmed bug: when the change is committed and the worktree is clean, `corvint affected --base <sha>` lists the committed paths under `plan.dirty` and reason `UNOWNED_DIRTY_PATH`, which reads as working-tree dirt.
title: affected --base on a clean worktree labels committed range paths as plan.dirty / UNOWNED_DIRTY_PATH
